decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin supports Google's current analytics standard and is central to the firm's announced analytics-driven, measurable-results positioning, so the firm has every reason to keep the development investment it has made.

Universal Analytics has been fully shut down, so the plugin's lack of value cannot be blamed on a temporary cause, and no public commitment or sunk cost can justify keeping it rather than moving clients and resources to GA4.
The relaunch SEO service is visibly committed on its own page, ties directly to the firm's core shop-relaunch business, and runs on existing specialist staff at low cost.

The SEO workshops were launched only recently and are presented on their own page, they fit the firm's search-marketing focus, and any weak early uptake can still be put down to a normal start-up phase.
